description: This file defines the 'FileManager' class within the Opencart admin controller namespace. It provides functionalities for managing files and directories such as listing, uploading, creating folders, and deleting files within the Opencart admin interface.

classes.name: FileManager
classes.description: Controller class providing file management capabilities in Opencart admin panel, handling file listing, upload, folder creation, and deletion.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the file manager view, loads language, prepares data, and renders the view template.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the file list response by invoking getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the directory listing, including files and subdirectories with pagination.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles file upload requests, validating permissions, file types, and moving uploaded files to the target directory.

methods.name: folder
methods.description: Creates a new directory in the specified path after validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified files or directories after validating permissions and safety checks.
